source.text: Breaking News: U.S. agencies have been advised that #Ottawa shooter was believed to be a #Canadian convert to #Islam, #FoxNews confirms.

selection_rule: Strict explicit stance only. Support means the comment accepts the source framing that Islam/convert identity is relevant, predictable, or tied to radical Islamist motive. Oppose means the comment rejects that framing as media bias, Islamophobia, overgeneralization, or an unfair linkage between Islam and violence.
note: Selected 30 explicit comments with balanced stances. Link-only, insult-only without clear stance, joke-only, and heavily ambiguous comments were excluded.
